TimerState.title: TimerState
TimerState.description: Active timer synchronization state across all devices for a given user.

durationMs.description: Total duration in milliseconds for the current session

targetEndTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the timer is scheduled to complete

remainingMs.description: Milliseconds remaining when paused or idle

sessionLabel.description: Optional user label for the focus session

completedSessionsCount.description: Number of consecutive focus sessions completed in this cycle (0-4)

updatedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last write for last-write-wins

updatedByDevice.description: Identifier or user agent hint for conflict debugging

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences for timer durations, notifications, sound, and theme.

longBreakInterval.description: Number of sessions before triggering a long break

autoStartBreaks.description: Whether breaks automatically start upon focus completion

autoStartFocus.description: Whether focus automatically starts upon break completion

soundEnabled.description: Whether soft completion chime sound plays

SessionRecord.title: SessionRecord
SessionRecord.description: Historical record of a completed focus or break session.

userId.description: UID of user who completed this session

label.description: User label assigned to the session

durationMinutes.description: Length of the completed session in minutes

dayKey.description: Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD for fast aggregation

TestConnection.title: TestConnection
TestConnection.description: Connection test document for health checks.

/users/{userId}/timer/state.description: Live synchronized timer state for the authenticated user

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Log of completed focus sessions for statistics and streak calculations

/test/connection.description: Health check document read on app boot
